extensionDescription.message: Generate SinDrawer sine-wave art from the slide title and set it as the Google Slides background in one click.

placeholderSeedText.message: Any text, e.g. the slide title

infoSlideUntitled.message: The current slide has no title; an empty seed is used.

infoAllSlidesSeed.message: "All slides" uses each slide's own title.

errorNotSlides.message: Open a Google Slides presentation to apply backgrounds. You can still copy or download the image.

errorOauthUnconfigured.message: OAuth is not configured. Set GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID in .env and rebuild (see README).

errorNotAuthorized.message: Connect your Google account to read slide titles and apply backgrounds.

errorSharingBlocked.message: Your Drive does not allow link sharing, so the image cannot be passed to Slides. Use Copy or Download instead.

errorStandalone.message: Running outside the extension: only preview, copy and download are available.
